verdict.rationale: Docs claim Kosmos produces a 'comprehensive cited report' with auditable findings and Falcon/Crow-style agents produce cited responses, analyses, statistical results, and figures, suggesting structured, shareable output. However there's no explicit mention of report formatting with distinct sections, tables, or a stakeholder-shareable summary format (e.g., PDF/Word export), and one probe shows the main cookbook page is broken (404), weakening confidence in the documentation's completeness. Missing for 10: explicit description of report structure (sections/tables/summary), export/sharing format, and independent verification of report quality.
